infotexts.entitydescription.cybercoreassistant: An incomplete metallic chassis. It seems to emanate an aura of incompetence.
infotexts.entitydescription.cybercorecaptain: An incomplete metallic chassis. Adorned with an admiral's crest, there is a strange sense of authority commanded by this vacant shell.
infotexts.entitydescription.cybercoremedic: An incomplete metallic chassis. A sickly aroma of blood is present, thinly veiled by sterile chemicals.
infotexts.entitydescription.cybercoremechanic: An incomplete metallic chassis. The faint sound of gears grinding can be heard from within.
infotexts.entitydescription.cybercoresecurity: An incomplete metallic chassis. Sporadic shockwaves shoot through the cold, hard, steel.
infotexts.entitydescription.cybercoreengineer: An incomplete metallic chassis. You can feel sharp jolts of electicity running through it.
infotexts.entitydescription.mannitolplus: An improved version of mannitol. It is used to quickly treat neurotrauma.
infotexts.entitydescription.artificialbrain: An artificial brain transplant that keeps a body alive when the original brain is removed.
infotexts.entitydescription.brainjar: A container to hold brain transplants indefinitely
infotexts.afflictiondescription.artificialbrain: The patient is permanently unconscious, but the body remains alive.
infotexts.afflictiondescription.triagetag_green: The patient has been gived the "minor" triage tag. They don't require treatment.
infotexts.afflictiondescription.triagetag_yellow: The patient has been gived the "delayed" triage tag. Their injuries are not life-threatening.
infotexts.afflictiondescription.triagetag_red: The patient has been gived the "immediate" triage tag. They require immediate treatment.
infotexts.afflictiondescription.triagetag_black: The patient has been gived the "deceased" triage tag. Medical attention is better spent elsewhere. They are as good as gone.
infotexts.entitydescription.triagetag: A label used for quick identification of the type and urgency of medical assistance required by a patient in the event of mass casualties.
infotexts.entitydescription.manualtriagetag: A manual distribution label. When applied to legs - green color, to arms - yellow, to torso - red, to head - black.
infotexts.entitydescription.experimentaltreatment: A highly experimental reagent that may cause as little or as much good or bad.
